capabilities.description: E2E-only capability -- adds the WebdriverIO test-hook plugin's permission. Defined INLINE here, never as a file under capabilities/, so the normal build never discovers or validates a `wdio:default` permission reference against plugins that aren't compiled in (tauri-plugin-wdio/tauri-plugin-wdio-webdriver are optional, gated by the e2e-testing Cargo feature this same config is always paired with).
